ui.faqCppQuestion: Do I need to know C++ to contribute?
ui.faqCppAnswer: No! Bitcoin Core uses C++, but many projects use Python, Rust, JavaScript, and other languages. Start with what you know.
ui.faqPythonAnswer: Absolutely! Many Bitcoin tools and libraries are written in Python. Check out pycoin and python-bitcoinlib.
ui.faqTimeAnswer: There's no fixed timeline. Focus on learning fundamentals, then start contributing to small issues. Every contribution matters.
ui.faqCoreExpertQuestion: Is Bitcoin Core only for experts?
ui.faqCoreExpertAnswer: Not at all! Start with documentation, testing, or small bug fixes. The community is welcoming to newcomers.
ui.faqMentorQuestion: How do I find a mentor?
ui.faqMentorAnswer: Join developer communities, attend meetups, and don't hesitate to ask questions. Many developers are happy to help.
ui.mentorsDesc: Meet the experienced Bitcoin developers who have been willing to work with us as mentors and guest developers, sharing their knowledge and guiding your journey.
